    color = tax_colors[tax]

    if is_lambada:

# --- Save ---

47	We compare the LAMBADA convergence pattern at two scales. At 1.3B parameters, convergence is monotonic: $\sigma$ decreases at every attention level from 0\% through 25\% ($\rho = -1.0$).
